purpose.gap: Freeze the remaining #517 survivor-control semantics before any Stage-1 outcome is opened so a future survivor cannot choose placebo or volatility-control definitions after seeing results.

market_beta.control: always-long ETH on the identical 05:00/17:00 UTC boundaries
market_beta.reason: Always-long ETH is a relevant lower-complexity market-beta baseline under #517: it uses the same asset, scored dates, fixed 05:00/17:00 UTC boundaries and unit gross exposure, while avoiding the candidate's active daytime sign switching. A Stage-2 survivor must demonstrate incremental after-cost value over it rather than treating it as diagnostic only.

simple_trend.control: night LONG plus daytime MOMENTUM sign of the immediately previous completed daytime return

simple_reversal.reason: The challenged daytime component is already the simplest one-lag sign reversal. Adding another 'simple reversal' would be a parameter variant, not a simpler independent baseline.

randomized_timing.control: causal randomized-lag daytime reversal placebo with lags 3..7 calendar trading dates; night remains LONG

one_period_delay.control: night LONG plus daytime reversal of the daytime return from exactly two calendar trading dates earlier

volatility_matched.control: the parent daytime-MOMENTUM sign-flip comparator on the exact same trading dates and exact same 05:00/17:00 boundaries
volatility_matched.reason: The candidate trades every eligible date at unit absolute daytime exposure (or zero on an exact-zero prior return), so there is no untreated same-window date pool to match. The sign-flip control is exactly co-temporal, same-asset, same-boundary and same-absolute-exposure, hence it shares the realized volatility state without a post-outcome caliper or resample.

market_beta_control.candidate_position_sequence: night LONG; daytime -sign(previous completed daytime return)
market_beta_control.control_position_sequence: LONG in both night and daytime sessions
market_beta_control.turnover_definition: absolute change in signed position at each session boundary; continuous LONG has zero turnover at an unchanged boundary
market_beta_control.comparison_rule: On every trading date where the candidate is legitimately defined, compare the candidate and always-long ETH with identical boundary-price and cost-accounting semantics. At 24 bps and 72 bps, candidate cumulative arithmetic net PnL must exceed always-long in the full 2026H1 replication and in both frozen chronological halves. Failure is mechanism-negative Stage-2 evidence; missing required data is DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE and cannot be rescued by dropping dates or redefining the beta baseline.

randomized_timing_placebo.purpose: Break the one-day signal timing relation while preserving PIT causality, the fixed 05:00/17:00 execution schedule, ETH exposure scale, night-long leg, and cost accounting.
randomized_timing_placebo.why_not_entry_timestamp_permutation: The primary strategy occupies every eligible day/night session. Permuting entry timestamps would either map occupied sessions to other occupied sessions or change the source-frozen UTC session mechanism itself. Randomizing the lag of the already-completed daytime information is the timing placebo that changes temporal alignment without changing the execution clock.
randomized_timing_placebo.common_support_reason: The maximum frozen lag is 7 calendar trading dates and 2026-01-01 is the earliest warmup daytime return. Starting 2026-01-08 guarantees every placebo signal references an already completed in-contract daytime return without acquiring 2025 data.
randomized_timing_placebo.day_position_rule: For UTC trading date D, choose K(D) deterministically from {3,4,5,6,7}; daytime position = -sign(daytime_return on exact UTC calendar date D-K(D)). Exact-zero source return => 0.
randomized_timing_placebo.lag_calendar_semantics: K counts UTC calendar trading dates, not previous available rows. Missing any required source or target session makes that target date DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE; dates are never skipped/reindexed to rescue the sample.
randomized_timing_placebo.turnover_definition: absolute change in signed position at each session boundary; long-to-short or short-to-long flip has turnover 2
randomized_timing_placebo.comparison_rule: Rescore the candidate and placebo on the identical frozen common-support dates. At 24 bps and 72 bps, candidate cumulative arithmetic net PnL must exceed placebo in the full common-support window and in each chronological half. Failure is mechanism-negative Stage-2 evidence; missing required data is inconclusive, never a redraw trigger.

volatility_matched_control.exact_zero_rule_both: 0 daytime exposure when the immediately previous daytime return is exactly zero
volatility_matched_control.comparison_rule: On every date where both are defined, candidate after-cost cumulative arithmetic net PnL must exceed the exact co-temporal momentum sign-flip control at 24 bps and 72 bps in the full replication and both frozen chronological halves. Missing required bars is DATA/PIT_INCONCLUSIVE, not permission to rematch.
